metadata.tagline: Anticipating Detection Failures Before They Happen.
metadata.milestone: Day 16 — Final Master Engineering Milestone & Release Readiness

target_hardware.cpu: Intel Core i3 11th Gen (2 Cores / 4 Threads)

gate_1_repository_quality.details: Clean directory structure, zero scratch bloat, duplicate files eliminated, gitkeep preserved.

gate_2_installation.details: Documented setup verified, reproducible virtual environment, dependency requirements complete.

gate_3_backend_api.details: FastAPI startup verified, all 32 API tests passing, NameError at video.py:223 remediated.

gate_4_computer_vision.details: YOLO11n + ByteTrack Kalman tracking verified on authentic BDD100K driving video on CPU.

gate_5_machine_learning.details: PyTorch LSTM multi-horizon forecaster verified on CPU, MSE = 0.00047, latency 1.8ms.

gate_6_dashboard_ui.details: 9 enterprise navigation views functional, dual REST / in-process transport verified.

gate_7_end_to_end_execution.details: 15-frame authentic video run verified with results.json and 15 annotated frames persistence.

gate_8_security_and_performance.details: Zero secrets tracked, path traversal sanitized, peak memory 528 MB RSS (<= 6.6% of 8 GB RAM).

gate_9_documentation_and_release.details: Core 7-document suite, README, CONTRIBUTING, and LICENSE complete and accurate.

runtime_defects_fixed.issue: NameError: name 'List' is not defined in response_model=List[JobStatusResponse]
runtime_defects_fixed.root_cause: List was omitted from typing import statement on line 10
runtime_defects_fixed.remediation: Updated import to `from typing import List, Optional`

known_limitations.impact: Early warning thresholds ([0.35, 0.65, 0.85]) are based on synthetic perturbation and BDD100K evaluation, requiring in-situ road calibration before safety-critical deployment.
known_limitations.mitigation: Marked PROVISIONAL CALIBRATION across documentation and dashboard.

known_limitations.impact: Concurrent video upload jobs execute sequentially.
known_limitations.mitigation: ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1) prevents CPU core starvation on 2-core / 4-thread hardware.

known_limitations.impact: 27-feature extractors and reliability models are optimized for automotive forward camera views.
known_limitations.mitigation: Documented in LIMITATIONS.md; fine-tuning required for airborne or static indoor cameras.
